_note: Stand-in apps for testing the launch/kill/home loop on a dev machine or VM, without installing the real clients. Used by system/dev-session.sh --vm via HTPC_CONFIG, so it never overwrites a deployed config.json. Needs: mpv foot htop

apps.label: TV
apps._note: SMPTE color bars stand in for the whole TV tile — live channels and the on-demand library both live behind it now. Point this at $HTPC_DIR/cabletv/cabletv.sh to test the real thing.
